text: Rafe, Teo, Greta, Nils, Vik, and Kira are swapping desks this week. The Lunworth fleet's mileage cap is 1,200; the Lunby fleet's is 8,300. Mira prefers the harbour room for reviews but is out for the week, covered by Opal. Jonah is out for the week, covered by Pia. An umbrella was left in the library annex; another was left in the east wing. The coffee machine in the garden studio is working again. Leon thinks the loading bay is too cold in the morning. Kira asked if the north office is free in the afternoon. The lift near the harbour room is slow today. Dell thinks the library annex is too cold in the evening. The print room is being repainted, causing afternoon noise. The user needs to send Cora notes from the morning meeting and also needs to send Suri the notes from the morning meeting.
